scope: Public Catalog filtering and visitor presentation
rootCauses: Exact Category equality and exact filter-policy scope excluded descendant leaf Products.
CHOICE did not represent multiple options with OR semantics.
Missing totals and four-item paging conflicted with twelve-item collection requests.
Fixed editorial spans, mobile image heights and generic detail grids conflicted with controlled responsive card proportions.
Filter display order followed generated UUIDs instead of localized labels.

dataSafety.mutationFixtures: Disposable PostgreSQL service databases, real owned Media files and staff sessions; teardown completed.

filterAcceptance.choice: Stable option IDs, OR inside an Attribute and AND across Attributes.
filterAcceptance.typedValues: Exact decimal strings/numeric SQL, boolean false, intentionally public/filterable TEXT.
filterAcceptance.state: Shared normalized URL/API/TanStack state; refresh/back/forward; changes reset page; paging preserves filters.
filterAcceptance.realIntegration: Staff publication, Attribute update and reviewed Category move change anonymous visitor results.
filterAcceptance.errors: Injected dependency failure renders retryable API error without demo/zero-result fallback.

presentation.category: Clear H1, breadcrumbs, description, contextual split hero and child/Products continuation.
presentation.home: Six Category fixtures, three/two/one columns, shared four-selected-Product grid.
presentation.cards: Stable full-width 4:3 media frames, bounded card variants and two useful public specifications.
presentation.listing: Hierarchical Category controls, dynamic filters, active chips, count, rail/drawer and server pagination.
presentation.detail: Unified gallery, deduplicated localized Group specifications, full-width mobile documents and shared related Product grid.
presentation.accessibility: One H1 on tested content routes, labeled controls/live result status; keyboard select, modal focus trap/Escape/restore, gallery/tabs and reduced-motion coverage; existing focus/contrast/font tokens retained.

performance.cardMediaProfile: card; demo image references preserve their explicit fixture URL.
performance.remaining: Existing bounded per-Product effective schema/projection queries; production load not benchmarked.

knownLimitations: No production provider, hosted CI or deployment acceptance claimed.
No production throughput or formal accessibility audit claimed.
Strict legacy category and singleton optionId aliases remain intentionally supported by the same endpoint.
